description: Redesign Tools Page Cards - Convert 3-column grid to single-column layout with two-panel cards showing tool info on left and preview images on right.

userStories.title: Add preview images to public directory
userStories.description: As a developer, I need preview images for each tool card so they can be displayed in the new layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Create directory public/images/tools/

Copy and rename Screenshot images to public/images/tools/ with web-friendly names: resume-checker-preview.png, grammar-checker-preview.png, resume-reviewer-preview.png, job-match-preview.png, cover-letter-generator-preview.png, cover-letter-checker-preview.png
Verify all 6 images exist in the target directory
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Define tool card data structure with ordering
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a constant array defining tool cards in the correct display order with image paths.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or update tools data array in src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/tools/page.tsx or separate data file
Each tool entry includes: id, titleKey, descriptionKey, icon, href, imagePath
Tools ordered: 1) Resume Checker, 2) Grammar Checker, 3) Resume Reviewer, 4) Job Match, 5) Cover Letter Generator, 6) Cover Letter Checker
Image paths point to /images/tools/[name]-preview.png
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Convert grid layout to single column
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see tools displayed in a single column so I can scan through them more easily.
acceptanceCriteria: Tools page displays cards in single vertical column
Remove existing 3-column grid CSS/classes (grid-cols-3 or similar)
Container has max-width and is centered (max-w-4xl mx-auto or similar)
Cards have vertical spacing between them (space-y-6 or gap-6)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: navigate to /en/tools and confirm single column layout

userStories.title: Create two-panel card layout
userStories.description: As a user, I want each card to show tool info on the left and a preview image on the right.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card has horizontal flex layout on desktop (md:flex-row)
Left panel (~40% width) contains: icon in colored badge, title, description
Right panel (~60% width) contains: preview image using Next.js Image component
Image has appropriate alt text for accessibility
Panels stack vertically on mobile (flex-col by default, md:flex-row)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: confirm two-panel layout on desktop

userStories.title: Add CTA button and card click navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want a clear button to access each tool while also being able to click anywhere on the card.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card has a visible CTA button with text from i18n (e.g., 'Try Now' or 'Use Tool')
Button positioned in left panel, below description
Button uses existing Button component with primary/teal styling
Entire card is wrapped in Link or has onClick navigating to tool page
Button click navigates without double navigation (stopPropagation or link structure)
Add translation key for button text in locale files (en, fr, de, it)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: click card and button, both navigate correctly

userStories.title: Implement mobile responsive layout
userStories.description: As a mobile user, I want the cards to display properly on small screens.
acceptanceCriteria: On screens < 768px (md breakpoint), card layout is vertical
Left content (icon, title, description, button) displays on top
Preview image displays below the content
Preview image scales appropriately (w-full, aspect ratio preserved)
Touch targets are appropriately sized (button min-h-11 or p-3)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: resize to mobile width (375px), confirm vertical layout

userStories.title: Style cards to match design mockups
userStories.description: As a user, I want the cards to look polished and match the provided design screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Card has subtle shadow (shadow-sm or shadow) and rounded corners (rounded-lg)
Card has border (border border-gray-200)
Card has hover state: subtle shadow increase or border color change
Left panel icon uses colored background badge (bg-teal-50 rounded-lg p-3)
Typography: title text-xl font-semibold, description text-gray-600
Consistent spacing using Tailwind scale (p-6, gap-4, etc.)
Preview image has rounded corners (rounded-lg)
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: compare against Screenshot/*.png mockups
